title: Imtihon kuni: strategiya va psixologiya
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz oxirgi hafta uchun kunma-kun reja, imtihon kuni tartibi va “agar–unda” rejalarini tuzasiz, stressni boshqarishning amaliy usullarini qo‘llaysiz, bir sahifalik shaxsiy takrorlash varag‘ini tayyorlaysiz va o‘z imtihon kuni rejangizni inglizcha yozasiz.

scenes.title: Imtihon kuniga tayyorgarlik
board: Exam Day: Strategy & Psychology
(Imtihon kuni: strategiya va psixologiya)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda yozish va o‘qish bo‘yicha to‘liq mock imtihon topshirdik, o‘zimizni baholadik va natijaga asoslangan reja tuzdik. Bugun bilim haqida emas, bilimni imtihon kuni to‘liq ko‘rsatish haqida gaplashamiz. Dars oxirida siz oxirgi hafta rejasini, imtihon kuni tartibini, stressga qarshi aniq usullarni va so‘nggi takrorlash varag‘ini tayyorlab, o‘z shaxsiy imtihon kuni rejangizni yozasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. You already have the knowledge. Today is about making sure that every bit of it turns up on the day.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Bilim sizda allaqachon bor. Bugun uning har bir zarrasi imtihon kuni ko‘rinishini ta’minlash haqida.

scenes.title: Bilim va natija
board: Score = knowledge × performance on the day
Same knowledge, different conditions → different scores
Today: 1 final week  2 routine  3 stress  4 last-minute review
scenes.say_native: Bir xil bilimga ega ikki nomzod turli ball olishi mumkin. Biri yaxshi uxlagan, vaqtni boshqargan va xotirjam; ikkinchisi tun bo‘yi o‘qigan, kechikkan va birinchi qiyin savolda sarosimaga tushgan. Bugun shu farqni boshqarishni o‘rganamiz. To‘rt mavzu bor: oxirgi hafta, imtihon kuni tartibi, stressni boshqarish va so‘nggi takrorlash. Hammasi oldindan rejalanadi, tasodifga qoldirilmaydi.
scenes.say: Two candidates with identical knowledge can walk out with very different scores. The difference is preparation for the day itself.
scenes.say_uz: Bir xil bilimli ikki nomzod juda turli ballar bilan chiqishi mumkin. Farq aynan imtihon kunining o‘ziga tayyorgarlikda.

scenes.title: Oxirgi hafta: mustahkamlash
board: Final week = consolidate, not learn
Taper: reduce volume, keep sharpness
Like an athlete before a race

examples.t: I'm tapering this week, so I'm only doing short, timed tasks.
examples.uz: Bu hafta yuklamani kamaytiryapman, shuning uchun faqat qisqa, vaqtli topshiriqlar bajaryapman.

scenes.say_native: Oxirgi haftaning asosiy qoidasi: yangi narsa o‘rganmang, borini mustahkamlang. Sportchilar musobaqadan oldin mashg‘ulot hajmini kamaytiradi, lekin tezlikni saqlaydi. Inglizcha buni “to taper” deyiladi. Siz ham shunday qiling: kamroq soat, lekin har kuni qisqa vaqtli mashq. Miyangiz charchoq bilan emas, tetiklik bilan imtihonga kirishi kerak.
scenes.say: Athletes taper before a race: less volume, same sharpness. Do the same. Shorter sessions, but keep working against the clock every day.
scenes.say_uz: Sportchilar musobaqadan oldin yuklamani kamaytiradi: hajm kamroq, keskinlik o‘sha-o‘sha. Siz ham shunday qiling. Qisqaroq mashg‘ulotlar, lekin har kuni soat bilan ishlashni davom ettiring.

scenes.title: Kunma-kun reja
board: Day 7: full mock (all papers)
Days 6–3: weakest areas + one timed section daily
Day 2: light review of your error log
Day 1: rest, logistics, early night
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna reja. Yettinchi kun: oxirgi to‘liq mock, barcha qismlar. Oltinchidan uchinchi kungacha: mockda aniqlangan eng zaif sohalar va har kuni bitta vaqtli bo‘lim. Ikkinchi kun: faqat o‘z xatolar daftaringizni yengil takrorlash. Imtihondan oldingi kun: dam olish, hujjatlar va yo‘lni tekshirish, erta uxlash. E’tibor bering, oxirgi to‘liq mock imtihondan bir hafta oldin, ikki kun oldin emas.
scenes.say: A full mock a week before, targeted work in the middle, a light review two days out, and a genuine rest day before the exam.
scenes.say_uz: Bir hafta oldin to‘liq mock, o‘rtada maqsadli ish, ikki kun oldin yengil takrorlash va imtihondan oldin haqiqiy dam olish kuni.

scenes.title: Rejani inglizcha aytish
board: Future perfect: By Friday I'll have done two mocks. (…qilgan bo‘laman)
Future continuous: On Sunday I'll be resting. (…yotgan bo‘laman)
Present continuous: I'm meeting my tutor on Tuesday.

examples.t: By Thursday I'll have reviewed my whole error log.
examples.uz: Payshanbagacha butun xatolar daftarimni takrorlab bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

examples.t: This time next week I'll be sitting the exam.
examples.uz: Kelasi hafta shu vaqtda imtihon topshirayotgan bo‘laman.

scenes.say_native: Rejani inglizcha ifodalashda uch shakl kerak. “By Friday I’ll have done” — future perfect, ma’lum vaqtgacha tugagan ish. O‘zbekchada bu “qilgan bo‘laman” ga juda yaqin. “I’ll be resting” — future continuous, kelajakdagi jarayon, o‘zbekcha “dam olayotgan bo‘laman”. Kelishilgan uchrashuvlar uchun esa present continuous: “I’m meeting my tutor”. O‘zbek tilidagi o‘xshashlik sizga katta yordam.
scenes.say: By Friday I'll have done two mocks. This time next week I'll be sitting the exam. And I'm meeting my tutor on Tuesday.
scenes.say_uz: Jumagacha ikkita mock qilgan bo‘laman. Kelasi hafta shu vaqtda imtihon topshirayotgan bo‘laman. Seshanba kuni ustozim bilan uchrashaman.

scenes.title: Xato: tiqib yodlash va zamon
board: ✗ Learning 300 new idioms the night before
✓ Reviewing YOUR 10 most frequent errors
✗ By Friday I will finish all my mocks.
✓ By Friday I will have finished all my mocks.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi strategik: imtihon arafasida yangi idiomalar ro‘yxatini yodlash yoki tun bo‘yi o‘qish. Bizda “oxirgi kecha hammasini takrorlab chiqaman” degan odat keng tarqalgan, lekin charchagan miya bilganini ham yaxshi eslay olmaydi. Ikkinchisi grammatik: “by Friday” bilan oddiy kelasi zamon emas, future perfect kerak, chunki ish o‘sha vaqtgacha tugagan bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Cramming new material the night before only adds noise. And with by plus a deadline, use the future perfect: by Friday I will have finished.
scenes.say_uz: Arafada yangi materialni tiqib yodlash faqat shovqin qo‘shadi. By va muddat bilan future perfect ishlating: jumagacha tugatgan bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Rejani to‘ldiring
board: 1 By Wednesday I ___ (finish) my last full mock.
2 This time on Saturday I ___ (relax) at home.
3 I ___ (see) my tutor at four tomorrow — it's arranged.
4 By the time the exam starts, I ___ (eat) a proper breakfast.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt gapni to‘g‘ri shakl bilan to‘ldiring. Signal so‘zlarga qarang: “by Wednesday” va “by the time” tugallangan ishni, “this time on Saturday” jarayonni, “it’s arranged” esa kelishilgan rejani bildiradi. O‘zbekcha tarjimasini ichingizda aytib ko‘ring: “tugatgan bo‘laman” yoki “dam olayotgan bo‘laman”. Bu sizga to‘g‘ri shaklni topishda yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Complete the plan. Watch the signals: by Wednesday, this time on Saturday, it's arranged, and by the time the exam starts.
scenes.say_uz: Rejani to‘ldiring. Signallarga qarang: chorshanbagacha, shanba kuni shu vaqtda, kelishilgan va imtihon boshlanguncha.

scenes.title: Javoblar: kelasi zamon shakllari
board: 1 will have finished
2 will be relaxing
3 am seeing
4 will have eaten
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “will have finished”, chorshanbagacha tugagan. Ikkinchi: “will be relaxing”, shanba kuni shu paytda jarayon davom etadi. Uchinchi: “am seeing”, kelishilgan uchrashuv, bu yerda “see” ning ma’nosi “uchrashmoq”. To‘rtinchi: “will have eaten”, imtihon boshlanishidan oldin tugagan. Agar to‘rttasi ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, rejangizni inglizcha aniq yoza olasiz.
scenes.say: Will have finished. Will be relaxing. Am seeing. Will have eaten. Two completed actions, one action in progress, and one arrangement.
scenes.say_uz: Tugatgan bo‘laman. Dam olayotgan bo‘laman. Uchrashaman. Yeb bo‘lgan bo‘laman. Ikki tugallangan ish, bir jarayon va bir kelishuv.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: oxirgi hafta
board: Listening 1: two friends, five days before the exam
Listen for: plans, worries, advice
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Imtihondan besh kun oldin ikki do‘st gaplashyapti. Ulardan biri tiqib yodlamoqchi, ikkinchisi esa yuklamani kamaytirgan. Kim nima qilishni rejalagani, nimadan xavotirlanayotgani va qanday maslahat berilganiga quloq soling. Dialogdan keyin uchta savol beriladi.
scenes.say: Dilnoza: I'm planning to pull an all-nighter on Thursday and go through every idiom list I've got. Sam: Seriously? You've done three full mocks already. Dilnoza: I know, but I keep thinking I've forgotten everything. Sam: That's just nerves talking. I'm tapering: one timed section a day, and by Wednesday I'll have gone through my error log twice. On Thursday I'll be doing absolutely nothing. Dilnoza: Nothing? Sam: Well, packing my bag. And sleeping.
scenes.say_uz: Dilnoza: Payshanba kuni tun bo‘yi o‘qib, hamma idiomalar ro‘yxatini ko‘rib chiqmoqchiman. Sam: Jiddiymisan? Allaqachon uchta to‘liq mock qilgansan. Dilnoza: Bilaman, lekin hammasini unutgandekman. Sam: Bu shunchaki hayajon gapiryapti. Men yuklamani kamaytiryapman: kuniga bitta vaqtli bo‘lim va chorshanbagacha xatolar daftarimni ikki marta ko‘rib chiqqan bo‘laman. Payshanba kuni umuman hech narsa qilmayman. Dilnoza: Hech narsa? Sam: Xo‘sh, sumkamni yig‘aman. Va uxlayman.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: savollar
board: 1 What is Dilnoza planning to do on Thursday?
2 Why does Sam think she doesn't need to?
3 What will Sam have done by Wednesday?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Dilnoza payshanba kuni nima qilmoqchi? Ikkinchi: Sam nega bunga ehtiyoj yo‘q deb o‘ylaydi? Uchinchi: chorshanbagacha Sam nima qilgan bo‘ladi? Uchinchi savolga javobda future perfect ishlating. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni qayta tinglang.
scenes.say: What is Dilnoza planning to do on Thursday? Why does Sam think she doesn't need to? And what will Sam have done by Wednesday?
scenes.say_uz: Dilnoza payshanba kuni nima qilmoqchi? Sam nega bunga ehtiyoj yo‘q deb o‘ylaydi? Chorshanbagacha Sam nima qilgan bo‘ladi?

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: javoblar
board: 1 Pull an all-nighter and go through every idiom list
2 She has done three mocks; the fear is just nerves
3 He will have gone through his error log twice.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: tun bo‘yi o‘qib, barcha idiomalar ro‘yxatini ko‘rib chiqmoqchi. “Pull an all-nighter” — tun bo‘yi uxlamay ishlash degani. Ikkinchi: u allaqachon uchta mock qilgan, “hammasini unutdim” degan tuyg‘u esa shunchaki hayajon. Uchinchi: “He will have gone through his error log twice.” Samning rejasi bugungi darsdagi barcha tamoyillarga mos keladi.
scenes.say: She wants to pull an all-nighter. Sam reminds her she has done three mocks, and that the feeling of forgetting everything is just nerves. By Wednesday he will have gone through his error log twice.
scenes.say_uz: U tun bo‘yi o‘qimoqchi. Sam unga uchta mock qilganini va hammasini unutish tuyg‘usi shunchaki hayajon ekanini eslatadi. Chorshanbagacha u xatolar daftarini ikki marta ko‘rib chiqqan bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Imtihon arafasi
board: ID / confirmation / pens & pencils / watch (if allowed) / water
Route + travel time + a backup plan
Two alarms; normal bedtime
scenes.say_native: Imtihon arafasida kechqurun sumkani yig‘ing: shaxsni tasdiqlovchi hujjat, ro‘yxatdan o‘tish tasdig‘i, ruchka va qalamlar, suv. Imtihon markazining qoidalarini oldindan o‘qing, chunki nimani olib kirish mumkinligi markazga qarab farq qiladi. Yo‘lni va vaqtni tekshiring, zaxira variant ham bo‘lsin. Ikkita budilnik qo‘ying va odatdagi vaqtda yoting, juda erta emas.
scenes.say: Pack your bag the night before, check the centre's rules about what you can take in, plan your route with a backup, and set two alarms.
scenes.say_uz: Sumkangizni kechqurun yig‘ing, markazning nimani olib kirish mumkinligi haqidagi qoidalarini tekshiring, yo‘lingizni zaxira bilan rejalang va ikkita budilnik qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Imtihon kuni ertalab
board: Familiar breakfast — nothing new
Arrive early, not rushed
Switch on your English: read or speak aloud for 10 min

examples.t: I always read a short article aloud on the bus to switch my English on.
examples.uz: Ingliz tilimni “yoqish” uchun avtobusda doim qisqa maqolani ovoz chiqarib o‘qiyman.

scenes.say_native: Ertalab tanish nonushta qiling, yangi taom yoki odatdagidan ko‘p kofe sinab ko‘rmang. Shoshilmay, erta yetib boring. Eng foydali odat: ingliz tilini “yoqish”. Yo‘lda o‘n daqiqa inglizcha maqola o‘qing yoki o‘zingiz bilan inglizcha gaplashing. Uydan o‘zbekcha yoki ruscha fikrlab chiqsangiz, birinchi topshiriq miyani “isitish”ga ketadi. Ingliz tilini imtihondan oldin ishga tushiring.
scenes.say: Eat what you always eat, arrive early, and switch your English on before you walk in. Read aloud or talk to yourself for ten minutes, so the first task isn't your warm-up.
scenes.say_uz: Doim yeydiganingizni yeng, erta yetib boring va kirishdan oldin ingliz tilingizni yoqing. O‘n daqiqa ovoz chiqarib o‘qing yoki o‘zingiz bilan gaplashing, shunda birinchi topshiriq isinish bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Imtihon xonasida
board: 1 Read the instructions — every word
2 Write your stop times
3 Easy first, mark hard ones, come back
4 Never leave a multiple-choice blank
scenes.say_native: Xonada to‘rt qoida. Birinchi: ko‘rsatmalarni oxirigacha o‘qing, ba’zan topshiriq formati kutilganidan farq qiladi. Ikkinchi: to‘xtash vaqtlarini yozing. Uchinchi: qiyin savolga yopishib qolmang, belgilab qo‘yib, keyin qayting. To‘rtinchi: agar noto‘g‘ri javob uchun ball ayirilmasa, test savolini hech qachon bo‘sh qoldirmang. Taxminiy javob ham imkoniyat, bo‘sh joy esa aniq nol.
scenes.say: Read every instruction, write your stop times, skip and return, and unless wrong answers lose marks, never leave a multiple-choice question blank.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir ko‘rsatmani o‘qing, to‘xtash vaqtlarini yozing, o‘tkazib keyin qayting va noto‘g‘ri javob uchun ball ayirilmasa, test savolini hech qachon bo‘sh qoldirmang.

scenes.title: Xato: imtihon kuni yangilik
board: ✗ a new pen, an energy drink, a new strategy
✗ arriving at the last minute
✓ Nothing new on exam day
✓ Rehearse the routine during your last mock
scenes.say_native: Imtihon kuni hech qanday yangilik bo‘lmasin. Yangi ruchka yozmay qolishi, energetik ichimlik yurak urishini tezlashtirishi, mock’da sinab ko‘rilmagan yangi strategiya esa chalkashtirishi mumkin. Kechikib, yugurib kirish esa butun birinchi soatni buzadi. Yechim: oxirgi to‘liq mock’ni aynan imtihon kunidagidek o‘tkazing, xuddi o‘sha nonushta, o‘sha vaqt, o‘sha tartib bilan.
scenes.say: Nothing new on exam day. Not a pen, not a drink, not a strategy. Rehearse the whole routine during your last mock, so the real day feels familiar.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon kuni hech qanday yangilik yo‘q. Na ruchka, na ichimlik, na strategiya. Butun tartibni oxirgi mock’da mashq qiling, shunda haqiqiy kun tanish tuyuladi.

scenes.title: Tartibni tiklang
board: a write your stop times  b pack your bag  c familiar breakfast
d read the instructions  e read an article aloud on the way
f set two alarms  g check the centre's rules online
Put them in the right order.
scenes.say_native: Doskadagi yetti qadamni to‘g‘ri tartibga keltiring: kechqurundan boshlab, imtihon xonasidagi birinchi daqiqalargacha. Ba’zi qadamlar o‘rnini almashtirish mumkin, lekin mantiqiy ketma-ketlik bo‘lishi kerak. Har qadamni inglizcha gap bilan ayting, masalan, “First, I’ll check the centre’s rules online.”
scenes.say: Put the seven steps in order, from the evening before to your first minutes in the exam room. Say each one as a full sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Yetti qadamni kechqurundan imtihon xonasidagi birinchi daqiqalargacha tartibga keltiring. Har birini to‘liq gap bilan ayting.

scenes.title: Javob: to‘g‘ri tartib
board: Evening: g → b → f
Morning: c → e
Exam room: d → a
scenes.say_native: Namuna tartib. Kechqurun: avval markaz qoidalarini tekshirasiz, keyin shunga qarab sumkani yig‘asiz, so‘ng ikkita budilnik qo‘yasiz. Ertalab: tanish nonushta, keyin yo‘lda maqolani ovoz chiqarib o‘qish. Xonada: avval ko‘rsatmalarni o‘qiysiz, keyin to‘xtash vaqtlarini yozasiz. E’tibor bering, qoidalarni sumkadan oldin tekshirish mantiqiy, chunki ular nimani olishni belgilaydi.
scenes.say: Check the rules, pack your bag, set your alarms. Breakfast, then read aloud on the way. Read the instructions, then write your stop times.
scenes.say_uz: Qoidalarni tekshiring, sumkani yig‘ing, budilnik qo‘ying. Nonushta, keyin yo‘lda ovoz chiqarib o‘qish. Ko‘rsatmalarni o‘qing, keyin to‘xtash vaqtlarini yozing.

scenes.title: Nazoratchi bilan muloqot
board: Excuse me, could I have another sheet, please?  /kʊdaɪ/
Sorry, my pen's run out. Could I borrow one?
Would it be possible to open a window?
Polite: soft tone + please; ✗ flat 'Give paper.'
scenes.say_native: Imtihonda nazoratchiga murojaat qilishingiz mumkin. Iboralar doskada. Talaffuzga e’tibor bering: “could I” bog‘lanib, “kʊdaɪ” bo‘lib eshitiladi. Muloyimlik ohangda: yumshoq, biroz ko‘tariluvchi ohang va “please”. O‘zbek va rus tillarida buyruq shaklidagi qisqa iltimos odatiy bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin inglizchada “Give paper” qo‘pol eshitiladi. Savol shaklidagi iltimos ishlating.
scenes.say: Excuse me, could I have another sheet, please? Sorry, my pen's run out; could I borrow one? Notice how could I links together, and how the tone stays soft.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, yana bir varaq olsam bo‘ladimi? Kechirasiz, ruchkamning siyohi tugadi, bittasini olib tursam bo‘ladimi? Could I qanday bog‘lanishi va ohang qanchalik yumshoqligiga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Muloyim iltimos
board: 1 You can't hear the listening recording well.
2 You need to go to the toilet.
3 You aren't sure if you can write in pencil.
Make a polite request for each.
scenes.say_native: Uch vaziyat uchun muloyim iltimos tuzing va ovoz chiqarib ayting. “Could I”, “Would it be possible” yoki “Is it all right if” bilan boshlang. Uchinchi vaziyatda bu iltimos emas, savol, shuning uchun boshqa tuzilma kerak bo‘lishi mumkin. Ohangni yumshoq saqlang.
scenes.say: You can't hear the recording well. You need to go to the toilet. You aren't sure whether you can write in pencil. What do you say?
scenes.say_uz: Yozuvni yaxshi eshitmayapsiz. Hojatxonaga borishingiz kerak. Qalam bilan yozish mumkinligini bilmaysiz. Nima deysiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar: iltimoslar
board: 1 Excuse me, I'm afraid I can't hear the recording very well.
2 Excuse me, would it be possible to go to the toilet?
3 Sorry, could you tell me if I'm allowed to write in pencil?
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchisida “I’m afraid” muammoni yumshatadi. Ikkinchisida “would it be possible” rasmiy va muloyim. Uchinchisida bilvosita savol: “could you tell me if I’m allowed”. Diqqat qiling, bilvosita savolda so‘z tartibi to‘g‘ri gapdagidek: “if I’m allowed”, “if am I allowed” emas. Bu o‘zbek o‘quvchilarida ko‘p uchraydigan xato.
scenes.say: Excuse me, I'm afraid I can't hear the recording very well. Would it be possible to go to the toilet? Could you tell me if I'm allowed to write in pencil?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, afsuski, yozuvni yaxshi eshitmayapman. Hojatxonaga borsam bo‘ladimi? Qalam bilan yozishga ruxsat bormi, ayta olasizmi?

scenes.title: Stress: dushman emas
board: Too little stress → careless
Too much stress → blank mind
Moderate stress → focus
Goal: manage it, not eliminate it
scenes.say_native: Stressni butunlay yo‘qotish maqsad emas. Juda kam hayajon beparvolikka olib keladi: odam savolni yuzaki o‘qiydi. Juda ko‘p hayajon miyani bo‘shatib qo‘yadi. O‘rtacha hayajon esa diqqatni jamlaydi. Oldingi darsda nafas olish va hayajonni qayta nomlashni ko‘rgan edik. Bugun ularga yana uch vosita qo‘shamiz: hozirga qaytish, “agar–unda” rejalari va ichki nutqni boshqarish.
scenes.say: You don't want zero stress; you want the right amount. A little pressure sharpens your focus. The aim is to manage it, not to make it disappear.
scenes.say_uz: Sizga nol stress kerak emas, to‘g‘ri miqdor kerak. Ozgina bosim diqqatni o‘tkirlaydi. Maqsad uni yo‘qotish emas, boshqarish.

scenes.title: Hozirga qaytish: 5-4-3-2-1
board: 5 things you can see
4 things you can feel
3 things you can hear
2 things you can smell · 1 slow breath
scenes.say_native: Fikrlar kelajakka, ya’ni “yiqilsam nima bo‘ladi” degan savolga qochganda, sizni hozirga qaytaradigan oddiy usul bor. Ko‘rib turgan beshta narsani, sezayotgan to‘rtta narsani, masalan oyog‘ingiz ostidagi polni, eshitayotgan uchta tovushni, hidini sezayotgan ikkita narsani nomlang va bitta sekin nafas oling. Buni xayolan, inglizcha qiling: bu ham tilni yoqadi.
scenes.say: Five things you can see, four you can feel, three you can hear, two you can smell, and one slow breath. Do it silently, in English.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rayotgan beshta, sezayotgan to‘rtta, eshitayotgan uchta, hidini sezayotgan ikkita narsa va bitta sekin nafas. Buni ichingizda, inglizcha qiling.

scenes.title: “Agar–unda” rejalari
board: If X happens, then I will Y.
If I don't know a word, then I'll guess from context and move on.
If I'm running out of time, then I'll write my conclusion first.
scenes.say_native: Eng kuchli vositalardan biri: oldindan tuzilgan “agar–unda” rejalari. Muammo yuz berganda qaror qabul qilish qiyin, chunki hayajon fikrlashni sekinlashtiradi. Shuning uchun qarorni oldindan qabul qilasiz: “Agar so‘zni bilmasam, kontekstdan taxmin qilaman va davom etaman.” Imtihonda faqat rejani bajarish qoladi. Grammatik tomondan e’tibor bering: “if” dan keyin present simple, “will” emas.
scenes.say: Decide in advance what you'll do when things go wrong. If I don't know a word, then I'll guess from context and move on. Under pressure, you just follow the plan.
scenes.say_uz: Ishlar noto‘g‘ri ketsa, nima qilishingizni oldindan hal qiling. Agar so‘zni bilmasam, kontekstdan taxmin qilaman va davom etaman. Bosim ostida siz shunchaki rejaga amal qilasiz.

scenes.title: Xato: fojiaviy ichki nutq
board: ✗ I've failed. Everything is ruined.
✓ It's one question out of fifty. Next.
✗ If I will panic, I will...
✓ If I panic, I'll...
scenes.say_native: Bitta qiyin savoldan keyin ichki ovoz: “Tamom, yiqildim, hammasi barbod.” Bu fojiaviylashtirish va u keyingi savollarga ham zarar beradi. Uni faktga aylantiring: “Bu ellik savoldan bittasi. Keyingisi.” Ichki nutqingiz ham ingliz grammatikasiga bo‘ysunsin: “If I will panic” xato, chunki shart ergash gapida “will” ishlatilmaydi. To‘g‘risi: “If I panic, I’ll take a breath.”
scenes.say: One hard question is not a failed exam. Replace everything is ruined with it's one question out of fifty; next. And remember: if I panic, not if I will panic.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta qiyin savol yiqilgan imtihon emas. Hammasi barbod o‘rniga bu ellik savoldan bittasi, keyingisi deng. Va esda tuting: if I panic, if I will panic emas.

scenes.title: O‘z “agar–unda” rejalaringiz
board: 1 Your mind goes blank in the speaking test.
2 You realise you misread a reading question.
3 Task 2 has only 20 minutes left and you've written half.
Write: If ..., then I'll ...
scenes.say_native: Uch vaziyat uchun “agar–unda” rejasini inglizcha yozing. Birinchisi gapirish imtihonida miya bo‘shab qolishi, ikkinchisi o‘qishda savolni noto‘g‘ri o‘qiganingizni tushunish, uchinchisi yozishda vaqt yetmayotgani. Har bir rejada aniq harakat bo‘lsin, “I’ll try to relax” kabi umumiy gap emas. Shart qismida present simple ishlating.
scenes.say: Write an if-then plan for each situation. Make the then part a concrete action, not just I'll try to relax.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir vaziyat uchun agar–unda rejasini yozing. Unda qismi aniq harakat bo‘lsin, shunchaki tinchlanishga harakat qilaman emas.

scenes.title: Javoblar: namuna rejalar
board: 1 If my mind goes blank, I'll say 'Let me think about that for a moment' and breathe out slowly.
2 If I realise I've misread a question, I'll fix it quickly and not dwell on it.
3 If I have 20 minutes left, I'll write a short conclusion first, then expand.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchisida ikki aniq harakat bor: vaqt yutish iborasi va sekin nafas chiqarish. Ikkinchisida asosiy so‘z “not dwell on it”, ya’ni qayta-qayta o‘ylamaslik: tuzating va unuting. Uchinchisi taktik: avval qisqa xulosa, chunki xulosasiz matn tugallanmagan ko‘rinadi, keyin vaqt qolsa, o‘rtani kengaytirasiz. Sizning rejalaringiz ham shunchalik aniqmi?
scenes.say: If my mind goes blank, I'll use a buying-time phrase and breathe out slowly. If I've misread something, I'll fix it and not dwell on it. If time is short, I'll write the conclusion first.
scenes.say_uz: Agar miyam bo‘shab qolsa, vaqt yutish iborasini ishlataman va sekin nafas chiqaraman. Agar noto‘g‘ri o‘qigan bo‘lsam, tuzataman va ustida qotib qolmayman. Vaqt kam bo‘lsa, avval xulosani yozaman.

scenes.title: Bo‘limlar orasida
board: Don't compare answers with other candidates
Water, a snack, a short walk
Close the last paper in your mind — it's finished
scenes.say_native: Bo‘limlar orasidagi tanaffusda nomzodlar odatda javoblarni solishtiradi: “Sen uchinchi savolga nima deding?” Bu eng zararli odat. Natijani o‘zgartira olmaysiz, lekin keyingi bo‘limga xavotir bilan kirasiz. O‘rniga suv iching, yengil gazak yeng, bir oz yuring. Oldingi bo‘limni xayolan yoping: u tugadi. Diqqatingiz endi faqat keyingisida.
scenes.say: Between papers, don't compare answers. You cannot change them, and you will carry the worry into the next paper. Drink some water, move a little, and close the last paper in your mind.
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘limlar orasida javoblarni solishtirmang. Ularni o‘zgartira olmaysiz va xavotirni keyingi bo‘limga olib kirasiz. Suv iching, biroz harakatlaning va oldingi bo‘limni xayolan yoping.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: tanaffusda
board: Listening 2: two candidates between papers
Listen for: the worry, the response, the plan
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Ikki nomzod o‘qish va yozish bo‘limlari orasidagi tanaffusda. Biri bitta savol ustida qotib qolgan, ikkinchisi esa vaziyatni boshqacha ko‘radi. Kim qanday ichki nutq ishlatayotgani va oxirida qanday reja tuzilganiga quloq soling. Mia ishlatgan “agar–unda” tuzilmasini ham topishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Jasur: Did you put B for question twelve? I'm sure it was C. I've probably messed up the whole section. Mia: Honestly, I'm not even going to think about it. It's done. Jasur: But if I got that one wrong... Mia: Then it's one question out of fifty. Look, we've got ten minutes. I'm getting some water and reading my essay phrases. Want to come? Jasur: Yeah. You're right. If I keep replaying it, I'll ruin the writing as well.
scenes.say_uz: Jasur: O‘n ikkinchi savolga B qo‘ydingmi? Men C ekaniga aminman. Ehtimol, butun bo‘limni buzdim. Mia: Rostini aytsam, bu haqda o‘ylamoqchi ham emasman. U tugadi. Jasur: Lekin agar o‘sha savolni xato qilgan bo‘lsam... Mia: Unda bu ellik savoldan bittasi. Qara, o‘n daqiqamiz bor. Men suv olib, esse iboralarimni o‘qiyman. Kelasanmi? Jasur: Ha. To‘g‘ri aytasan. Agar uni qayta-qayta o‘ylasam, yozishni ham buzaman.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: savollar
board: 1 What is Jasur worried about?
2 Which phrase shows Mia's attitude to the finished paper?
3 What does Mia plan to do in the break?
4 What does Jasur finally realise?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: Jasur nimadan xavotirda? Ikkinchi: Mia tugagan bo‘limga munosabatini qaysi ibora bilan bildiradi? Uchinchi: Mia tanaffusda nima qilmoqchi? To‘rtinchi: oxirida Jasur nimani tushunadi? Javoblarni qisqa yozing va iloji bo‘lsa, dialogdagi iboralarni aynan keltiring.
scenes.say: What is Jasur worried about? How does Mia show her attitude to the finished paper? What will she do in the break? And what does Jasur finally realise?
scenes.say_uz: Jasur nimadan xavotirda? Mia tugagan bo‘limga munosabatini qanday ko‘rsatadi? U tanaffusda nima qiladi? Va oxirida Jasur nimani tushunadi?

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: javoblar
board: 1 Question 12 — he thinks he has messed up the section
2 'It's done.'
3 Get some water and read her essay phrases
4 Replaying it will ruin the writing too.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: o‘n ikkinchi savol, u butun bo‘limni buzdim deb o‘ylaydi, bu fojiaviylashtirish. Ikkinchi: “It’s done”, ya’ni u tugadi. Uchinchi: suv olish va esse iboralarini o‘qish, ya’ni keyingi bo‘limga tayyorlanish. To‘rtinchi: qayta-qayta o‘ylash yozishni ham buzadi. Diqqat qiling: “mess up” norasmiy frazali fe’l, “buzmoq, chuv tushirmoq” degani.
scenes.say: He's catastrophising about one question. She closes the paper with it's done, prepares for the next one, and he realises that replaying it would ruin the writing too.
scenes.say_uz: U bitta savol haqida fojiaviylashtiryapti. Mia bo‘limni it’s done bilan yopadi, keyingisiga tayyorlanadi, Jasur esa qayta o‘ylash yozishni ham buzishini tushunadi.

scenes.title: So‘nggi takrorlash: nimani?
board: Last 24 hours: only YOUR material
Your error log → top 10 mistakes
Your phrase bank: hedging, linking, buying time
Your timing plan for each paper
scenes.say_native: So‘nggi yigirma to‘rt soatda faqat o‘zingizning materialingizni takrorlang. Begona darslik yoki internetdagi “eng muhim idiomalar” ro‘yxati emas. Sizning xatolar daftaringizdagi eng ko‘p uchragan o‘nta xato, o‘zingiz tez-tez ishlatadigan iboralar va har bir bo‘lim uchun vaqt rejasi. Bu tanish material ishonch beradi, yangisi esa xavotir qo‘shadi.
scenes.say: In the last twenty-four hours, review only your own material: your ten most frequent errors, your phrase bank and your timing plan. Familiar material builds confidence; new material builds anxiety.
scenes.say_uz: So‘nggi yigirma to‘rt soatda faqat o‘z materialingizni takrorlang: eng ko‘p uchragan o‘nta xatoingiz, iboralar bankingiz va vaqt rejangiz. Tanish material ishonch, yangisi esa xavotir beradi.

scenes.title: Bir sahifalik varaq
board: ✗ I live here since 2019 → ✓ I have lived
✗ discuss about → ✓ discuss
✗ the life is hard → ✓ life is hard
Hedging: It could well be that... / There's a case for...
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy bir sahifalik varaq doskada. Unda sizning shaxsiy xatolaringiz: “since” bilan present perfect, “discuss about” emas “discuss”, umumiy ma’nodagi otlarda artikl ishlatmaslik, masalan “life is hard”. Ostida esa tayyor iboralar va vaqt rejasi. Bu varaqni imtihondan oldingi kechqurun va ertalab bir martadan o‘qing. Uni xonaga olib kirmaysiz, albatta, faqat oldin o‘qiysiz.
scenes.say: One page: your personal errors with corrections, a handful of phrases, and your timing plan. Read it the evening before and once in the morning, and then put it away.
scenes.say_uz: Bir sahifa: tuzatishlari bilan shaxsiy xatolaringiz, bir nechta ibora va vaqt rejangiz. Uni arafada kechqurun va ertalab bir marta o‘qing, keyin olib qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Xato: hammasini takrorlash
board: ✗ Rereading the whole grammar book the night before
✗ Checking forums for 'what will be in the exam'
✓ One page, read twice, then rest
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: arafada butun grammatika kitobini qayta o‘qish. Hajm shunchalik ko‘pki, siz faqat qancha narsani bilmasligingizni his qilasiz. Ikkinchisi: forumlarda “imtihonda nima tushadi” degan mish-mishlarni o‘qish. Bu hech qanday foyda bermaydi, faqat xavotirni oshiradi. Bir sahifa, ikki marta o‘qish, keyin dam. Ana shu yetarli.
scenes.say: Rereading a whole grammar book the night before only shows you how much there is. Exam rumours online only raise your anxiety. One page, twice, then rest.
scenes.say_uz: Arafada butun grammatika kitobini qayta o‘qish faqat qancha narsa borligini ko‘rsatadi. Internetdagi imtihon mish-mishlari faqat xavotirni oshiradi. Bir sahifa, ikki marta, keyin dam.

scenes.title: Varaqqa nima kiradi?
board: A a list of 200 new idioms  B your 10 most frequent errors
C your essay plan template  D a complete grammar textbook
E 5 hedging phrases you already use  F your time budget
G an exam rumour from a forum
scenes.say_native: Doskadagi yetti narsadan qaysilari so‘nggi takrorlash varag‘iga kiradi, qaysilari yo‘q? Har biri uchun qisqa sabab ayting. Bugungi tamoyilni eslang: faqat o‘zingizning, tanish va bir sahifaga sig‘adigan material. Masalan, ikki yuzta yangi idioma tanish materialmi yoki yangi? Shunday savolni har bir variantga bering.
scenes.say: Which of these belong on your one-page sheet, and which don't? Give a reason for each.
scenes.say_uz: Bulardan qaysilari bir sahifalik varag‘ingizga kiradi, qaysilari kirmaydi? Har biri uchun sabab ayting.

scenes.title: Javob: B, C, E, F
board: ✓ B, C, E, F — your own, familiar, fits on one page
✗ A new material  ✗ D too much  ✗ G rumour, no value
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob: B, C, E va F. Ular sizning shaxsiy, tanish va bir sahifaga sig‘adigan materialingiz. A yangi material, arafada uni o‘rganib ulgurmaysiz. D juda katta hajm. G esa mish-mish, uning foydasi yo‘q. Agar E variantida “already use” so‘zlariga e’tibor bergan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib: aynan siz ishlatadigan iboralar varaqqa kiradi, yangilari emas.
scenes.say: B, C, E and F: your own, familiar, and short. A is new, D is far too much, and G is just a rumour.
scenes.say_uz: B, C, E va F: o‘zingizniki, tanish va qisqa. A yangi, D juda ko‘p, G esa shunchaki mish-mish.

scenes.title: Kirishdan oldingi o‘n daqiqa
board: Put your notes away
Speak or think in English
One breath cycle + one if-then plan
Walk in: 'I'm ready.'
scenes.say_native: Xonaga kirishdan oldingi o‘n daqiqada qaydlarni yig‘ishtiring. Bu vaqtda yangi narsa eslab qolmaysiz, faqat xavotir orttirasiz. O‘rniga inglizcha o‘ylang yoki gapiring, bir marta nafas mashqini bajaring va eng muhim “agar–unda” rejangizni ichingizda takrorlang. Xonaga “Men tayyorman” degan fikr bilan kiring. Bu o‘zini aldash emas: siz haqiqatan tayyorlangansiz.
scenes.say: In the last ten minutes, put your notes away. Think in English, breathe, repeat your key if-then plan, and walk in knowing that you are ready.
scenes.say_uz: Oxirgi o‘n daqiqada qaydlaringizni olib qo‘ying. Inglizcha o‘ylang, nafas oling, asosiy agar–unda rejangizni takrorlang va tayyor ekaningizni bilib xonaga kiring.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: shaxsiy reja
board: My exam-day plan:
1 Final week (day by day)  2 Evening before  3 Morning
4 In the exam room + 3 if-then plans  5 My one-page sheet
Use: will have done / will be doing / If..., I'll...
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy ijodiy topshiriq. Darsni to‘xtating va o‘z imtihon kuni rejangizni inglizcha yozing. Besh bo‘lim: oxirgi hafta kunma-kun, arafa kechqurun, ertalab, imtihon xonasi va uchta “agar–unda” rejasi, hamda bir sahifalik varaq mazmuni. Bugungi grammatikani ishlating: future perfect, future continuous va shart gaplar. Yozib bo‘lgach, namuna bilan solishtiramiz.
scenes.say: Write your own exam-day plan in English, in five sections. Use the future perfect, the future continuous and if-then sentences.
scenes.say_uz: O‘z imtihon kuni rejangizni inglizcha, besh bo‘limda yozing. Future perfect, future continuous va agar–unda gaplarini ishlating.

scenes.title: Namuna reja
board: By Monday I'll have done my last full mock.
The evening before, I'll be packing my bag by eight.
If I can't answer a question, I'll mark it and move on.
My sheet: 10 errors, 6 phrases, timing for each paper
scenes.say_native: Namuna rejadan parchalar doskada. E’tibor bering, har bir gap aniq va tekshirsa bo‘ladigan: qachon, nima, qanday. “By Monday I’ll have done my last full mock” — muddat va natija. “If I can’t answer a question, I’ll mark it and move on” — tayyor qaror. O‘z rejangizni shu bilan solishtiring: noaniq gaplar bormi? Bo‘lsa, ularga vaqt, son yoki aniq harakat qo‘shing.
scenes.say: By Monday I'll have done my last full mock. If I can't answer a question, I'll mark it and move on. Every line is specific enough to check.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanbagacha oxirgi to‘liq mock’ni qilgan bo‘laman. Agar savolga javob bera olmasam, belgilab, davom etaman. Har bir satr tekshirsa bo‘ladigan darajada aniq.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Final week: taper — consolidate, don't cram
Routine: nothing new; switch your English on
Stress: manage it — 5-4-3-2-1, if-then plans, factual self-talk
Last-minute: one page of YOUR material
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Oxirgi haftada yuklamani kamaytirasiz, yangi narsa o‘rganmaysiz, faqat mustahkamlaysiz. Imtihon kuni hech qanday yangilik yo‘q va ingliz tilingizni oldindan yoqasiz. Stressni yo‘qotmaysiz, boshqarasiz: hozirga qaytish, “agar–unda” rejalari va faktga asoslangan ichki nutq. So‘nggi takrorlash esa bir sahifa, faqat sizning materialingiz.
scenes.say: Taper, don't cram. Keep the routine familiar. Manage stress with plans, not hope. And review one page of your own material. You are ready.
scenes.say_uz: Yuklamani kamaytiring, tiqib yodlamang. Tartibni tanish saqlang. Stressni umid bilan emas, rejalar bilan boshqaring. Va o‘z materialingizdan bir sahifani takrorlang. Siz tayyorsiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: write your personal exam-day plan (5 sections)
Success: day-by-day week, 3 if-then plans, one-page sheet, correct future forms
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: shaxsiy imtihon kuni rejangizni inglizcha yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: oxirgi hafta kunma-kun rejalangan, arafa, ertalab va imtihon xonasi uchun aniq qadamlar bor, kamida uchta “agar–unda” rejasi va bir sahifalik takrorlash varag‘i tayyor, future perfect va shart gaplar to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan. Keyingi darsda C2 yakuniy imtihonini topshirib, sertifikat olasiz.
scenes.say: Write your personal exam-day plan, with a day-by-day final week, three if-then plans and your one-page sheet. Next time: the final C2 exam and your certificate.
scenes.say_uz: Shaxsiy imtihon kuni rejangizni yozing: oxirgi hafta kunma-kun, uchta agar–unda rejasi va bir sahifalik varaq bilan. Keyingi safar: C2 yakuniy imtihoni va sertifikatingiz.

homework_uz: Shaxsiy imtihon kuni rejangizni inglizcha yozing (besh bo‘lim: oxirgi hafta, arafa kechqurun, ertalab, imtihon xonasi, bir sahifalik varaq). Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: oxirgi hafta kunma-kun rejalangan; kamida uchta aniq “If ..., I’ll ...” rejasi bor; bir sahifalik varaqda o‘zingizning eng ko‘p uchragan xatolaringiz, iboralaringiz va vaqt rejangiz jamlangan; future perfect, future continuous va shart gaplar to‘g‘ri ishlatilgan.

quiz.q: What is the main aim of the final week before the exam?
options: Learn as many new idioms as possible
Do a full mock every day
quiz.why_uz: Oxirgi haftada yangi narsa o‘rganilmaydi, bori mustahkamlanadi va yuklama kamaytiriladi.

options: By Friday I will finish all my mocks.
By Friday I will have finished all my mocks.
By Friday I finish all my mocks.
By Friday I am finishing all my mocks.
quiz.why_uz: “By + muddat” bilan tugallangan ish uchun future perfect ishlatiladi (o‘zbekcha “tugatgan bo‘laman”).

quiz.q: 'This time next week I ___ the exam.'
quiz.why_uz: Kelajakdagi aniq paytda davom etayotgan jarayon uchun future continuous: “will be sitting”.

quiz.q: Which is the best advice for exam-day morning?
options: Eat a familiar breakfast and switch your English on
quiz.why_uz: Imtihon kuni yangilik bo‘lmaydi; tanish nonushta va ingliz tilini oldindan “yoqish” foydali.

quiz.q: Which if-then plan is grammatically correct?
options: If I will panic, I will breathe.
If I panic, I'll breathe out slowly.
If I panic, I breathed slowly.
quiz.why_uz: Shart ergash gapida (if-qism) “will” ishlatilmaydi: If I panic, I’ll...

quiz.q: Which is the most polite request to an invigilator?
options: Excuse me, could I have another sheet, please?
quiz.why_uz: Inglizchada iltimos savol shaklida, “could I” va “please” bilan muloyim eshitiladi.

options: Could you tell me if am I allowed to use a pencil?
Could you tell me if I'm allowed to use a pencil?
Could you tell me am I allowed to use a pencil?
Could you tell me if allowed I am to use a pencil?
quiz.why_uz: Bilvosita savolda so‘z tartibi darak gapdagidek: if I’m allowed.

quiz.q: After a difficult question, which self-talk is most helpful?
options: It's one question out of fifty. Next.
quiz.why_uz: Fojiaviylashtirish o‘rniga faktga asoslangan ichki nutq diqqatni keyingi savolga qaytaradi.

quiz.q: What should you do between papers?
options: Drink water, move a little and close the last paper in your mind
quiz.why_uz: Javoblarni solishtirish natijani o‘zgartirmaydi, faqat xavotirni keyingi bo‘limga olib kiradi.

quiz.q: Which item belongs on your one-page last-minute sheet?
options: An exam rumour from a forum
quiz.why_uz: So‘nggi takrorlashda faqat o‘zingizning, tanish materialingiz: eng ko‘p uchragan xatolaringiz.
